An '''interior broadcast suite''' was a vehicle modification to broadcast chosen auditory entertainment across a vessel. For many [[Species/Legends|species]], [[Music/Legends|music]] served as a primary source of amusement and an important cultural touchstone, so many [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], due to their transient lifestyles, installed this technology. The [[Interior Broadcaster System]] by [[Tagge Company/Legends|Tagge Company]] and the [[Shipboard Music Suite]] by [[Celta-corp]] were such interior broadcast suites.<ref name="Fly" />
